fields.name: Data subjects
fields.description:
In this step, you specify who the people are whose personal data you will be processing. Individually, we refer to these people as "data subjects", and as a group, we refer to them as "data subject groups". You must specify at least one group. There is no maximum.

For each group, we ask two things:

  1. The name you want to use for the relevant group.
  2. Why it is necessary to use personal data of these data subjects.
  3. Which specific categories of personal data you will be processing, subdivided into special (extra sensitive), sensitive, and normal.
fields.description_en:
In this step, you specify who the people are whose personal data you will be processing. Individually, we refer to these people as "data subjects", and as a group, we refer to them as "data subject groups". You must specify at least one group. There is no maximum.

For each group, we ask two things:

  1. The name you want to use for the relevant group.
  2. Why it is necessary to use personal data of these data subjects.
  3. Which specific categories of personal data you will be processing, subdivided into special (extra sensitive), sensitive, and normal.
fields.description_nl:
In deze stap geef je op wie de mensen zijn van wie je persoonsgegevens gaat verwerken. Individueel noemen we deze mensen "datasubjecten" en als groep spreken we van "datasubjectgroepen". Je moet minimaal één groep opgeven. Er geldt geen maximum.
Per groep vragen we drie dingen:
  1. De naam die je voor de desbetreffende groep wilt gebruiken.
  2. Waarom het noodzakelijk is om persoonsgegevens van deze datasubjecten te gebruiken.
  3. Welke specifieke categorieën persoonsgegevens je gaat verwerken, onderverdeeld in bijzonder (extra gevoelig), gevoelig en normaal.

fields.name: Recipients
fields.description: By recipients, we mean: individuals or institutions outside Utrecht University with whom you share your previously provided personal data. This includes other universities, clients, data scientists, or other external institutions.
fields.description_en: By recipients, we mean: individuals or institutions outside Utrecht University with whom you share your previously provided personal data. This includes other universities, clients, data scientists, or other external institutions.
fields.description_nl: Onder ontvangers verstaan we: personen of instellingen buiten de Universiteit Utrecht met wie je de eerder opgegeven persoonsgegevens deelt. Denk aan andere universiteiten, aan opdrachtgevers, data scientists of andere externe instellingen.

fields.name: Software
fields.description:
Indicate which software packages and (cloud) applications you will be using. Standard office software you use from your local laptop (e.g., Excel, Word) does not need to be listed.
To check which packages have been approved by the UU, consult the Tooladvisor in advance.
fields.description_en:
Indicate which software packages and (cloud) applications you will be using. Standard office software you use from your local laptop (e.g., Excel, Word) does not need to be listed.
To check which packages have been approved by the UU, consult the Tooladvisor in advance.
fields.description_nl:
Geef aan welke softwarepakketten en (cloud)applicatie(s) je gaat gebruiken. Reguliere kantoorsoftware die je vanaf je lokale laptop gebruikt (bijv. Excel, Word) hoef je niet op te voeren.
Om te controleren welke pakketten zijn goedgekeurd door de UU raadpleeg je vooraf de Tooladvisor.

fields.name: Security
fields.description: In this step, you can indicate which technical and organizational measures you have taken or will take to protect the personal data in your study. You can add your own measures if necessary. Note: Not all measures below may be relevant to your study.
fields.description_en: In this step, you can indicate which technical and organizational measures you have taken or will take to protect the personal data in your study. You can add your own measures if necessary. Note: Not all measures below may be relevant to your study.
fields.description_nl: In deze stap kun je aangeven welke technische en organisatorische maatregelen je hebt genomen of gaat nemen om de persoonsgegevens binnen je studie te beveiligen. Indien nodig kun je zelf maatregelen toevoegen. Let op: Wellicht zijn niet alle onderstaande maatregelen relevant voor jouw studie.

fields.name: Overview
fields.description: Please review your answers below and return to previous steps to make any necessary changes. When you are ready to submit, click the 'Submit' button.
fields.description_en: Please review your answers below and return to previous steps to make any necessary changes. When you are ready to submit, click the 'Submit' button.
fields.description_nl: Bekijk hieronder je antwoorden en ga terug naar eerdere stappen om eventuele wijzigingen aan te brengen. Klik op de knop 'Indienen' om je inzending te versturen.

fields.text: What do we mean by 'a study'?
fields.text_en: What do we mean by 'a study'?
fields.text_nl: Wat verstaan we onder een studie?
fields.content: The definition of a study can be found in de faq.
fields.content_en: The definition of a study can be found in de faq.
fields.content_nl: Definitie studie is te vinden op de faq.

fields.text: What will the specified name be used for?
fields.text_en: What will the specified name be used for?
fields.text_nl: Wordt de naam die ik opgeef vaker gebruikt?
fields.content: This name will be used in all formal correspondence.
fields.content_en: This name will be used in all formal correspondence.
fields.content_nl: Deze naam zal worden gebruikt in alle formele correspondentie.

fields.text: What happens to the data I enter?
fields.text_en: What happens to the data I enter?
fields.text_nl: Wat gebeurt er met de data die ik invoer?
fields.content: The data that you enter will be checked where needed completed by the privary officer. As soon as all data have correctly been registered, your registration in the processing register is legally valid. This registration can be viewed by the management of your faculty, by the co-researchers that you yourself have added, by the data protection officer and by the privacy officier. If needed, the registration can be reopended by you or by the privacy officier.
fields.content_en: The data that you enter will be checked where needed completed by the privary officer. As soon as all data have correctly been registered, your registration in the processing register is legally valid. This registration can be viewed by the management of your faculty, by the co-researchers that you yourself have added, by the data protection officer and by the privacy officier. If needed, the registration can be reopended by you or by the privacy officier.
fields.content_nl: De data die je invoert, worden gecontroleerd en waar nodig aangevuld door de privacy officer. Zodra alle data naar behoren zijn ingevuld, is er sprake van een rechtsgeldige registratie in het verwerkingsregister. Deze registratie kan in ieder geval worden ingezien door het management van je faculteit, door de collega-onderzoekers die je zelf opgeeft, door de functionaris voor gegevensbescherming en door de privacy officers van de UU. Indien nodig kan de registratie door jou of de privacy officer worden heropend om wijzigingen aan te brengen.

fields.text: I already entered this information in another place. Why do I have to enter it again?
fields.text_en: I already entered this information in another place. Why do I have to enter it again?
fields.text_nl: Ik heb deze informatie al ergens anders opgegeven. Waarom wordt dit hier weer gevraagd?
fields.content: Often multiple applications demand entering the same data. We strive to avoid any double data input, but in the current application, this cannot be avoided. In the future, this register will be extended with data required for assessment by the FEtC-H. Data will then need to be entered only once.
fields.content_en: Often multiple applications demand entering the same data. We strive to avoid any double data input, but in the current application, this cannot be avoided. In the future, this register will be extended with data required for assessment by the FEtC-H. Data will then need to be entered only once.
fields.content_nl: Vaak moet je voor verschillende toepassingen dezelfde gegevens opgeven. We streven ernaar om dergelijk dubbel werk zo veel mogelijk te beperken. Met dit register zijn we echter nog niet zo ver. In de toekomst worden de in te vullen data uitgebreid met data die nodig zijn voor toetsing door de FETC. Gegevens hoef je dan nog maar één keer op te geven.

fields.text: What do we mean by person with final responsibility?
fields.text_en: What do we mean by person with final responsibility?
fields.content: The person with final responsibilitiy is a researcher with a doctorate, a supervisor with a doctorate or a PhD supervisor
fields.content_en: The person with final responsibilitiy is a researcher with a doctorate, a supervisor with a doctorate or a PhD supervisor
fields.content_nl: De eindverantwoordelijk onderzoeker is een gepromoveerd onderzoeker, een gepromoveerde begeleider of een promotor.

fields.text: How do we define co-researchers?
fields.text_en: How do we define co-researchers?
fields.content: Co-researchers are those who have been involved in this (part of the) research from the start, and with whom we may have to set up an agreement about joint responsibility.
fields.content_en: Co-researchers are those who have been involved in this (part of the) research from the start, and with whom we may have to set up an agreement about joint responsibility.
fields.content_nl: Medeonderzoekers zijn mensen die al vanaf het begin bij dit specifieke (deel-) onderzoek betrokken zijn en met wie we eventueel een regeling of overeenkomst inzake gezamenlijke verantwoordelijkheid moeten aangaan

fields.text: What happens when I add a co-researcher to this registration?
fields.text_en: What happens when I add a co-researcher to this registration?
fields.text_nl: Wat gebeurt er als ik een medeonderzoeker toevoeg aan deze registratie?
fields.content: At the moment, you need to notify co-researchers yourself about this registration. In the future, an automatic mail will be sent to them from MyResearch.
fields.content_en: At the moment, you need to notify co-researchers yourself about this registration. In the future, an automatic mail will be sent to them from MyResearch.
fields.content_nl: Momenteel moet je zelf medeonderzoekers op de hoogte stellen dat zij genoemd zijn in deze registratie. In de toekomst zullen zij vanuit MyResearch een automatische mail ontvangen.

fields.text: What do I enter for UU colleagues?
fields.text_en: What do I enter for UU colleagues?
fields.text_nl: Wat vul ik in bij collega's van de UU?
fields.content: For UU colleagues, enter their UU-email address.
fields.content_en: For UU colleagues, enter their UU-email address.
fields.content_nl: Bij collega’s van de UU vul je hun UU-e-mailadres in.

fields.text: What do I enter if someone is not working at UU?
fields.text_en: What do I enter if someone is not working at UU?
fields.text_nl: Wat vul ik in als iemand niet werkzaam is bij de UU?
fields.content: For colleagues outside UU, enter their professional email address. Please note: Gmail or any other USA provider is not acceptable.
fields.content_en: For colleagues outside UU, enter their professional email address. Please note: Gmail or any other USA provider is not acceptable.
fields.content_nl: Bij collega’s van buiten de UU vul je hun professionele e-mailadres in. Let op: een mailadres op bijvoorbeeld Gmail of een andere Amerikaanse provider is niet acceptabel.

fields.text: Do 'faculty' and 'department' refer to the researcher with final responsibility or to the study?
fields.text_en: Do 'faculty' and 'department' refer to the researcher with final responsibility or to the study?
fields.text_nl: Hebben de faculteit en afdeling betrekking op de eindverantwoordelijke of op de studie?
fields.content: This concerns the faculty/department of the researcher with final responsibility.
fields.content_en: This concerns the faculty/department of the researcher with final responsibility.
fields.content_nl: Het gaat om de faculteit/afdeling van de eindverantwoordelijke.

fields.text: What happens if multiple faculties take part in the study?
fields.text_en: What happens if multiple faculties take part in the study?
fields.text_nl: Wat als een studie door meerdere faculteiten wordt uitgevoerd?
fields.content: In all cases, only the coordinating faculty should be entered.
fields.content_en: In all cases, only the coordinating faculty should be entered.
fields.content_nl: In alle gevallen is er slechts één faculteit waar het onderzoek is ondergebracht, de zgn. penvoerende faculteit.

fields.text: What happens if the expected study period has passed?
fields.text_en: What happens if the expected study period has passed?
fields.text_nl: Wat gebeurt er als de verwachte studieperiode is verstreken?
fields.content:
After the study period has passed, the archiving period starts. In principle, this period lasts at least 10 years.

Should the study take longer or shorter than expected, please return to MyResearch and update the study period.
fields.content_en:
After the study period has passed, the archiving period starts. In principle, this period lasts at least 10 years.

Should the study take longer or shorter than expected, please return to MyResearch and update the study period.
fields.content_nl:
Na afloop van de studieperiode gaat de archiveringsperiode in. Deze duurt in beginsel minimaal 10 jaar.

Mocht jouw studie langer of korter duren dan hier gepland, kom dan terug naar MyResearch en pas de studieperiode aan.

fields.text: What do we mean by 'start date'?
fields.text_en: What do we mean by 'start date'?
fields.content: The start date is the date where you begin communicating with potential participants (that can happen at the same time as the start of data collecting but in many cases you start with communication with potential participants).
fields.content_en: The start date is the date where you begin communicating with potential participants (that can happen at the same time as the start of data collecting but in many cases you start with communication with potential participants).
fields.content_nl: De begindatum is de datum waarop je begint met het benaderen van mogelijke deelnemers (dat kan tegelijk zijn met de start van de dataverzameling, maar in veel gevallen neem je eerst contact op met mogelijke deelnemers).

fields.text: What do we mean by 'end date'?
fields.text_en: What do we mean by 'end date'?
fields.content: This is the expected publication date of the research results. This date is the start date of the archiving period period. Please enter an estimated date here that is as accurate as possible.
fields.content_en: This is the expected publication date of the research results. This date is the start date of the archiving period period. Please enter an estimated date here that is as accurate as possible.
fields.content_nl: Dit is de verwachte publicatiedatum van de onderzoeksresultaten. Op deze datum gaat de archiveringsperiode van de onderzoeksdata in. Geef hier een zo correct mogelijke geschatte datum op.

fields.text: What do we mean by research goal?
fields.text_en: What do we mean by research goal?
fields.content:
The research goal can mean two things:

  1. the research goal you want to answer or the hypothesis you want to prove;
  2. that which you aim to achieve with this study (for example a systematic overview of something).
fields.content_en:
The research goal can mean two things:

  1. the research goal you want to answer or the hypothesis you want to prove;
  2. that which you aim to achieve with this study (for example a systematic overview of something).
fields.content_nl:
Het onderzoeksdoel kan twee dingen betekenen:

  1. de onderzoeksvraag die je wilt beantwoorden of de hypothese die je wilt bewijzen;
  2. datgene wat je met je studie wilt bereiken (bijvoorbeeld een systematisch overzicht van iets).

fields.text: When do I have multiple goals?
fields.text_en: When do I have multiple goals?
fields.content: There are multiple goals when your research questions, hypothesis or things you want to achieve can not be grouped under a single denominator.
fields.content_en: There are multiple goals when your research questions, hypothesis or things you want to achieve can not be grouped under a single denominator.
fields.content_nl: Er is sprake van meerdere doelen als je onderzoeksvragen, je hypothesen of de dingen die je wilt bereiken, niet onder één noemer te vatten zijn.

fields.text: What are personal data?
fields.text_en: What are personal data?
fields.content: Personal data are data that say something about a living person. Think of name, adress data, age, sex. But also for example audio or video records, anwers of questions, observations and notes. Data are only personal data if they can be traced back to a person.
fields.content_en: Personal data are data that say something about a living person. Think of name, adress data, age, sex. But also for example audio or video records, anwers of questions, observations and notes. Data are only personal data if they can be traced back to a person.
fields.content_nl: Persoonsgegevens zijn gegevens die iets zeggen over een levend persoon. Denk aan naam, adresgegevens, leeftijd, geslacht etc. Maar ook bijvoorbeeld audio- of video-opnamen, antwoorden op vragen, observaties en aantekeningen. Gegevens zijn alleen persoonsgegevens als ze terug te voeren zijn op een bepaalde persoon.

fields.text: Why do I need to enter 'categories' of personal data?
fields.text_en: Why do I need to enter 'categories' of personal data?
fields.content: Personal data are data such as "Jan", "Yasmina" or "12-07-1934". Categories of personal data are for example "first name" or "birth date". In the processing register you enter the categories of data, not the data itself.
fields.content_en: Personal data are data such as "Jan", "Yasmina" or "12-07-1934". Categories of personal data are for example "first name" or "birth date". In the processing register you enter the categories of data, not the data itself.
fields.content_nl: Persoonsgegevens zijn gegevens zoals "Jan", "Yasmina" of "12-07-1934". Categorieën persoonsgegevens zijn dan bijvoorbeeld "Voornaam" of "Geboortedatum". In het verwerkingsregister leg je alleen de categorieën vast, niet de persoonsgegevens zelf.

fields.text: Is it allowed to collect data that I will not need right now?
fields.text_en: Is it allowed to collect data that I will not need right now?
fields.text_nl: Mag ik gegevens verzamelen die ik nu niet nodig heb?
fields.content: In principle that is not allowed. The data you collect need to confirm to the concrete goal. Collecting data just in case you may need it for a future research goal is not enough. You need concrete indications that you will need the data in the future.
fields.content_en: In principle that is not allowed. The data you collect need to confirm to the concrete goal. Collecting data just in case you may need it for a future research goal is not enough. You need concrete indications that you will need the data in the future.
fields.content_nl: In principe niet. De gegevens die je verzamelt moeten beantwoorden aan het geformuleerde doel. Data alvast verzamelen met de gedachte dat er later misschien een onderzoeksvraag is waarvoor ze nodig zijn, is niet genoeg. Je moet concrete aanwijzingen hebben dat je de data in de toekomst nodig gaat hebben.

fields.text: What are datasubjects?
fields.text_en: What are datasubjects?
fields.content: Datasubjects are persons from whom you process data. If you interview somebody that person is a datasubject.
fields.content_en: Datasubjects are persons from whom you process data. If you interview somebody that person is a datasubject.
fields.content_nl: Datasubjecten zijn personen van wie je persoonsgegevens verwerkt, dus op wie die persoonsgegevens betrekking hebben. Als je iemand interviewt, dan is diegene het datasubject.

fields.text: Why do I need to enter 'categories' of data subjects?
fields.text_en: Why do I need to enter 'categories' of data subjects?
fields.content: Datasubjects are individual persons with an own name. Categories of datasubjects are persons that can be grouped together. For example student, UU-colleagues, childeren with dyslexia, or police officers. Be as specific as possible when grouping data subjects.
fields.content_en: Datasubjects are individual persons with an own name. Categories of datasubjects are persons that can be grouped together. For example student, UU-colleagues, childeren with dyslexia, or police officers. Be as specific as possible when grouping data subjects.
fields.content_nl: Datasubjecten zijn individuele personen met een eigen naam. Categorieën datasubjecten zijn groepen personen die binnen eenzelfde categorie vallen. Bijvoorbeeld: studenten, UU-medewerkers, kinderen met dyslexie of politieambtenaren. Wees bij het opgeven van categorieën datasubjecten zo specifiek mogelijk.

fields.text: Do I need to enter something for every category?
fields.text_en: Do I need to enter something for every category?
fields.text_nl: Moet ik bij elke categorie iets opgeven?
fields.content: No, you do not have to do so. You only have to enter the categories datasubjects where you process peronal data. There can be multiple different groups datasubjects per category. For example at participants you can have teachers and students.
fields.content_en: No, you do not have to do so. You only have to enter the categories datasubjects where you process peronal data. There can be multiple different groups datasubjects per category. For example at participants you can have teachers and students.
fields.content_nl: Nee, dat hoeft niet. Je moet alleen die categoriën datasubjecten opgeven van wie je persoonsgegevens verwerkt. Per categorie kunnen dat wel meerdere, verschillende, groepen datasubjecten zijn, bijv. bij 'Deelnemers, d.w.z. personen die bewust deelnemen aan het onderzoek': docenten en leerlingen.

fields.text: What do I do when my category is not shown?
fields.text_en: What do I do when my category is not shown?
fields.text_nl: Wat moet ik doen als mijn categorie er niet tussen staat?
fields.content: The shown categories are expected to be complete. If you think you are unable to proceed please contact the privacy officer.
fields.content_en: The shown categories are expected to be complete. If you think you are unable to proceed please contact the privacy officer.
fields.content_nl: De opgevoerde categorieën zijn geacht uitputtend te zijn. Mochten je desondanks de indruk hebben niet door te kunnen, neem dan contact op met de privacy officer.

fields.text: Who/what are recipients?
fields.text_en: Who/what are recipients?
fields.content: A recipient is a person or an organization that receives personal data from another organization and that has its own purposes for receiving and further processing that personal data. Example: as a researcher, you provide data (including personal data) to another university that will use it for their own research. Another example: you make your research data available to a national archive.
fields.content_en: A recipient is a person or an organization that receives personal data from another organization and that has its own purposes for receiving and further processing that personal data. Example: as a researcher, you provide data (including personal data) to another university that will use it for their own research. Another example: you make your research data available to a national archive.
fields.content_nl: Een ontvanger is een persoon of organisatie die persoonsgegevens ontvangt van een andere organisatie en die voor het ontvangen en verder verwerken van die persoonsgegevens eigen doelstellingen heeft. Voorbeeld: als onderzoeker verstrek jij data (inclusief persoonsgegevens) aan een andere universiteit die er zelf onderzoek mee gaat doen. Ander voorbeeld: je stelt je onderzoeksdata beschikbaar aan een nationaal archief.

fields.text: Who/what are third parties?
fields.text_en: Who/what are third parties?
fields.content: See 'Who/what are recipients?'
fields.content_en: See 'Who/what are recipients?'
fields.content_nl: Zie 'Wie/wat zijn ontvangers?'

fields.text: What is cloud software?
fields.text_en: What is cloud software?
fields.content:
With cloud software we mean applications that are offered through internet, such as Qualtrics, SURFDrive or Office 365.

Cloud software runs on big server farms somewhere in the world. The exact location can differ. GDPR demands that personal data are processed within the EER.
fields.content_en:
With cloud software we mean applications that are offered through internet, such as Qualtrics, SURFDrive or Office 365.

Cloud software runs on big server farms somewhere in the world. The exact location can differ. GDPR demands that personal data are processed within the EER.
fields.content_nl:
Onder cloudsoftware verstaan we applicaties die via internet worden aangeboden, bijv. Qualtrics, SURFDrive of Office 365.

Cloudsoftware draait op grote serverparken ergens ter wereld. De precieze locaties kunnen verschillen. Vanuit de AVG wordt geëist dat persoonsgegevens binnen de EER worden verwerkt.

fields.text: Which software has been approved by the UU?
fields.text_en: Which software has been approved by the UU?
fields.text_nl: Welke software is goedgekeurd door de UU?
fields.content: Please consult the Tooladvisor. Do keep in mind that the Tooladvisor is not always up to date. If you have any questions, please contact the IT Service Desk.
fields.content_en: Please consult the Tooladvisor. Do keep in mind that the Tooladvisor is not always up to date. If you have any questions, please contact the IT Service Desk.
fields.content_nl: Raadpleeg de Tooladvisor. Houd er rekening mee dat de Tooladvisor niet altijd actueel is. Voor vragen kun je terecht bij de IT Service Desk.

fields.text: What should I do when I use unapproved software anyway?
fields.text_en: What should I do when I use unapproved software anyway?
fields.text_nl: Wat moet ik doen als ik toch niet-goedgekeurde software gebruik?
fields.content: The use of non-approved software needs to be reported as soon as possible, in principle even before you are going to use that software for the processing of personal data. The privacy officer will then check if the software meets GDPR requirements.
fields.content_en: The use of non-approved software needs to be reported as soon as possible, in principle even before you are going to use that software for the processing of personal data. The privacy officer will then check if the software meets GDPR requirements.
fields.content_nl: Het gebruik van niet-goedgekeurde software moet je zo snel mogelijk melden, in principe vóórdat je die software gaat inzetten voor het verwerken van persoonsgegevens. De privacy officer gaat dan na of die software aan alle AVG-regels voldoet.

fields.text: What security measures are standard at the UU?
fields.text_en: What security measures are standard at the UU?
fields.text_nl: Welke beveiligingsmaatregelen zijn er standaard bij de UU?
fields.content: The UU has taken a large number of technical and organizational measures to increase the security of personal data. For example, the technical infrastructure is secured in a multitude of ways (such as multi-factor authentication, firewalls, and antivirus software), and binding agreements have been concluded to compel IT service providers to ensure the protection of personal data.
fields.content_en: The UU has taken a large number of technical and organizational measures to increase the security of personal data. For example, the technical infrastructure is secured in a multitude of ways (such as multi-factor authentication, firewalls, and antivirus software), and binding agreements have been concluded to compel IT service providers to ensure the protection of personal data.
fields.content_nl: De UU heeft een groot aantal technische en organisatorische maatregelen getroffen om de beveiliging van persoonsgegevens te verhogen. Zo is de technische infrastructuur op een veelheid aan manieren beveiligd (denk aan multi-factor authenticatie, firewalls en antivirussoftware) en zijn er bindende overeenkomsten gesloten om de leveranciers van IT-diensten te dwingen de bescherming van persoonsgegevens te waarborgen.

fields.text: What if I do not have any of the documents listed?
fields.text_en: What if I do not have any of the documents listed?
fields.text_nl: Wat als ik geen van de genoemde documenten heb?
fields.content: You are not required to submit any additional documents.
fields.content_en: You are not required to submit any additional documents.
fields.content_nl: Het is niet verplicht om extra documenten aan te leveren.

fields.text: What is a DPIA?
fields.text_en: What is a DPIA?
fields.content:
A DPIA (data protection impact assessment) is a document that is only required when the processing of personal data contains great risks for the persons (such as participants or the researchers themself), the UU or society. The DPIA contains a systematic description of the research, an inventory of the risks and an overview of the measures taken to reduce the risk as much as possible.

If you suspect that your research has great risks please contact the privacy officer asap.
fields.content_en:
A DPIA (data protection impact assessment) is a document that is only required when the processing of personal data contains great risks for the persons (such as participants or the researchers themself), the UU or society. The DPIA contains a systematic description of the research, an inventory of the risks and an overview of the measures taken to reduce the risk as much as possible.

If you suspect that your research has great risks please contact the privacy officer asap.
fields.content_nl:
Een DPIA (data protection impact assessment) is een document dat alleen nodig is wanneer de verwerking van persoonsgegevens grote risico’s met zich meebrengt voor personen (zoals de deelnemers of de onderzoeker zelf), voor de universiteit of voor de maatschappij als geheel. De DPIA bevat een systematische beschrijving van het onderzoek, een inventarisatie van de risico’s en een overzicht van maatregelen om die risico’s zo veel mogelijk te beperken.
Denk je dat jouw onderzoek grote risico’s oplevert? Neem dan zo snel mogelijk contact op met de privacy officer.

fields.text: What is a data management plan?
fields.text_en: What is a data management plan?
fields.content: A data management plan is a structured overview of the management of research data. Both for during and after the research. The FEtC-H has a strong preference for the following template.
fields.content_en: A data management plan is a structured overview of the management of research data. Both for during and after the research. The FEtC-H has a strong preference for the following template.
fields.content_nl: Een datamanagementplan is een gestructureerd overzicht van het beheer van onderzoeksgegevens zowel gedurende als na het onderzoek. (De FETC-GW heeft een grote voorkeur voor deze template.)

fields.text: How do I create a data management plan?
fields.text_en: How do I create a data management plan?
fields.content: Please use this template and/or please contact the data management at datamanagement.gw@uu.nl or datamanagement.rebo@uu.nl.
fields.content_en: Please use this template and/or please contact the data management at datamanagement.gw@uu.nl or datamanagement.rebo@uu.nl.
fields.content_nl: Gebruik hiervoor een template bijvoorbeeld template en/of neem contact op met de datamanager datamanagement.gw@uu.nl of datamanagement.rebo@uu.nl.

fields.text: How do I modify documents?
fields.text_en: How do I modify documents?
fields.content: You can modify and resubmit documents so long your as study is still in the draft phase.
fields.content_en: You can modify and resubmit documents so long your as study is still in the draft phase.
fields.content_nl: Je kunt, voordat je een studie hebt ingediend, documenten opnieuw indienen.

fields.text: What is meant by the three categories for groups of data subjects?
fields.text_en: What is meant by the three categories for groups of data subjects?
fields.text_nl: Wat wordt er bedoeld met de drie categorieën voor groepen datasubjecten?
fields.content:
“Participants” refers to participants in the classical sense of the word. For example, people you interview, people who fill out a questionnaire, or people you subject to certain tests.
“People who do not (necessarily) know that research is being conducted on them” are, for example, people whose data you “scrape” on social media or people you secretly record in public spaces.
“People who are otherwise involved” are, for example, the parents of participating children (if you ask them to consent to their child's participation or personal data processing) or location holders who are asked permission for the use of their location.
fields.content_en:
“Participants” refers to participants in the classical sense of the word. For example, people you interview, people who fill out a questionnaire, or people you subject to certain tests.
“People who do not (necessarily) know that research is being conducted on them” are, for example, people whose data you “scrape” on social media or people you secretly record in public spaces.
“People who are otherwise involved” are, for example, the parents of participating children (if you ask them to consent to their child's participation or personal data processing) or location holders who are asked permission for the use of their location.
fields.content_nl:
Onder “Deelnemers” wordt verstaan: participanten in de klassieke zin van het woord. Bijvoorbeeld mensen die je interviewt of mensen die een vragenlijst invullen of die je aan bepaalde tests onderwerpt.
“Personen die niet (noodzakelijkerwijs) weten dat er onderzoek naar hen wordt gedaan” zijn bijvoorbeeld mensen van wie je data “scrapet” op social media of mensen van wie je in de publieke ruimte heimelijk opnamen maakt.
“Personen die anderszins betrokken zijn” zijn bijvoorbeeld de ouders van deelnemende kinderen (als je hen vraagt om toestemming te geven voor de deelname van hun kind) of locatiehouders die toestemming moeten geven voor het gebruik van hun locatie.

fields.text: What are special categories of personal data?
fields.text_en: What are special categories of personal data?
fields.content:
Special categories of personal data are data that are so sensitive that they are subject to extra protection under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). You may only process these data under additional conditions, for example, if you have obtained consent or if the persons to whom the data relate (the data subjects) have made those data public themselves.
The mentioned special categories of personal data must be interpreted “broadly”. For the category regarding political opinions, for example, it is not necessary for someone to be a member of a political party. Any opinion someone holds about the organization or functioning of society is considered a special category of personal data.
fields.content_en:
Special categories of personal data are data that are so sensitive that they are subject to extra protection under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). You may only process these data under additional conditions, for example, if you have obtained consent or if the persons to whom the data relate (the data subjects) have made those data public themselves.
The mentioned special categories of personal data must be interpreted “broadly”. For the category regarding political opinions, for example, it is not necessary for someone to be a member of a political party. Any opinion someone holds about the organization or functioning of society is considered a special category of personal data.
fields.content_nl:
Bijzondere persoonsgegevens zijn gegevens die zo gevoelig zijn dat ze onder de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) extra worden beschermd. Deze gegevens mag je alleen onder aanvullende voorwaarden verwerken, bijvoorbeeld als je er toestemming voor hebt gekregen of als degenen op wie de gegevens betrekking hebben (de datasubjecten) die gegevens zelf openbaar hebben gemaakt.
De genoemde categorieën bijzondere persoonsgegevens moet je “ruim” interpreteren. Voor de categorie over politieke opvattingen is het bijvoorbeeld niet nodig dat iemand lid is van een politieke partij. Elke opvatting die iemand heeft over de inrichting of het functioneren van de maatschappij wordt gezien als een bijzonder persoonsgegeven.

fields.text: What is two-factor authentication?
fields.text_en: What is two-factor authentication?
fields.content: Two-factor authentication (2FA) is a security method that improves security by identifying users in two ways, for example, through something you know (a specific password) and something you have (a specific phone).
fields.content_en: Two-factor authentication (2FA) is a security method that improves security by identifying users in two ways, for example, through something you know (a specific password) and something you have (a specific phone).
fields.content_nl: Twee-factor-authenticatie (2FA) is een beveiligingsmethode is een manier om de beveiliging te verbeteren door gebruikers op twee manieren te identificeren, bijvoorbeeld door iets dat je weet (een bepaald wachtwoord) en iets dat je hebt (een bepaalde telefoon).

fields.text: What is encryption?
fields.text_en: What is encryption?
fields.content: Encryption is a technique used to convert information into an encrypted form that is only accessible with a specific key. The goal of encryption is to protect information from unwanted access by unauthorized persons.
fields.content_en: Encryption is a technique used to convert information into an encrypted form that is only accessible with a specific key. The goal of encryption is to protect information from unwanted access by unauthorized persons.
fields.content_nl: Versleuteling (of encryptie) is een techniek waarmee informatie wordt omgezet in een versleutelde vorm die alleen toegankelijk is met een specifieke sleutel. Het doel van versleuteling is om de informatie te beschermen tegen ongewenste toegang door onbevoegde personen.

fields.text: What is a VPN?
fields.text_en: What is a VPN?
fields.content: A VPN (Virtual Private Network) encrypts your internet connection and routes your traffic through an intermediary server, making your IP address less visible. A VPN creates a kind of “conduit” between a sender and a receiver.
fields.content_en: A VPN (Virtual Private Network) encrypts your internet connection and routes your traffic through an intermediary server, making your IP address less visible. A VPN creates a kind of “conduit” between a sender and a receiver.
fields.content_nl: Een VPN (Virtual Private Network) versleutelt je internetverbinding en laat je verkeer via een tussenserver lopen, waardoor je IP-adres minder zichtbaar is. Een VPN creëert een soort “buizenpost” tussen een verzender en een ontvanger.

fields.text: What is the difference between anonymization and pseudonymization?
fields.text_en: What is the difference between anonymization and pseudonymization?
fields.text_nl: Wat is het verschil tussen anonimisering en pseudonimisering?
fields.content: With anonymization, it is permanently impossible to link your research data to specific individuals. With pseudonymization, this is indeed possible, for example by replacing personal data in a data file with codes and storing the meaning of those codes in a separate key file. With anonymization, the GDPR no longer applies, whereas it does with pseudonymization. Pseudonymization is primarily a security method.
fields.content_en: With anonymization, it is permanently impossible to link your research data to specific individuals. With pseudonymization, this is indeed possible, for example by replacing personal data in a data file with codes and storing the meaning of those codes in a separate key file. With anonymization, the GDPR no longer applies, whereas it does with pseudonymization. Pseudonymization is primarily a security method.
fields.content_nl: Bij anonimisering is het definitief onmogelijk om jouw onderzoeksgegevens in verband te brengen met specifieke personen. Bij pseudonimisering is dat wél mogelijk, bijvoorbeeld door persoonsgegevens in een databestand te vervangen door codes en de betekenis van die codes op te slaan in een afzonderlijk sleutelbestand. Bij anonimisering geldt de AVG niet meer, bij pseudonimisering wel. Pseudonimisering is in de eerste plaats een beveiligingsmethode.

fields.text: To what extent do agreements contribute to security?
fields.text_en: To what extent do agreements contribute to security?
fields.text_nl: In hoeverre dragen overeenkomsten bij aan de beveiliging?
fields.content: By making binding agreements with parties to whom we entrust personal data, the UU can enforce proper, secure, or lawful handling of that personal data by those parties.
fields.content_en: By making binding agreements with parties to whom we entrust personal data, the UU can enforce proper, secure, or lawful handling of that personal data by those parties.
fields.content_nl: Door bindende afspraken te maken met partijen aan wie we persoonsgegevens toevertrouwen, kan de UU die partijen dwingen tot een juiste, veilige of rechtmatige behandeling van die persoonsgegevens.

fields.text: What is a “Chinese wall”?
fields.text_en: What is a “Chinese wall”?
fields.content: If one department within an organization processes personal data that is also of interest to another department, but it is definitely not intended for that other department to see that data, management can impose a formal prohibition on that other department. In this way, the data is shielded internally within the organization. This is called a Chinese wall.
fields.content_en: If one department within an organization processes personal data that is also of interest to another department, but it is definitely not intended for that other department to see that data, management can impose a formal prohibition on that other department. In this way, the data is shielded internally within the organization. This is called a Chinese wall.
fields.content_nl: Als de ene afdeling binnen een organisatie persoonsgegevens verwerkt die ook interessant zijn voor een andere afdeling, maar het is beslist niet de bedoeling dat die andere afdeling die gegevens te zien krijgt, kan het management die andere afdeling een formeel verbod opleggen. Op die manier worden de gegevens intern binnen de organisatie afgeschermd. Dit wordt een Chinese wall genoemd.

fields.text: Why is the recipient’s country important?
fields.text_en: Why is the recipient’s country important?
fields.text_nl: Waarom is het land van de ontvanger van belang?
fields.content: Personal data may only be shared with recipients in countries that offer an adequate level of data protection. The EU countries, Norway, Iceland, and Switzerland (together the EEA) meet this requirement. Some other countries do as well. Arrangements must be made for transfers to countries that do not meet this requirement. For transfers to countries outside the EEA, please contact the privacy officer: privacy.gw@uu.nl or privacy.rebo@uu.nl
fields.content_en: Personal data may only be shared with recipients in countries that offer an adequate level of data protection. The EU countries, Norway, Iceland, and Switzerland (together the EEA) meet this requirement. Some other countries do as well. Arrangements must be made for transfers to countries that do not meet this requirement. For transfers to countries outside the EEA, please contact the privacy officer: privacy.gw@uu.nl or privacy.rebo@uu.nl
fields.content_nl: Persoonsgegevens mogen alleen worden gedeeld met ontvangers in landen die een afdoende niveau van gegevensbescherming bieden. De EU-landen, Noorwegen, IJsland en Zwitserland (samen de EER) voldoen aan deze eis. Sommige andere landen ook. Voor doorgifte aan landen die niet aan deze eis voldoen, moet er iets geregeld worden. Neem voor doorgifte aan landen buiten de EER contact op met de privacy officer: privacy.gw@uu.nl of privacy.rebo@uu.nl

fields.text: What is the basis for transfer?
fields.text_en: What is the basis for transfer?
fields.text_nl: Wat is de basis voor doorgifte?
fields.content: The transfer of personal data to countries other than the EU countries, Norway, Iceland, and Switzerland (together the EEA) is prohibited in principle, but there are several exceptions to make it possible. Discuss with the privacy officer (privacy.gw@uu.nl or privacy.rebo@uu.nl) which exception applies to you.
fields.content_en: The transfer of personal data to countries other than the EU countries, Norway, Iceland, and Switzerland (together the EEA) is prohibited in principle, but there are several exceptions to make it possible. Discuss with the privacy officer (privacy.gw@uu.nl or privacy.rebo@uu.nl) which exception applies to you.
fields.content_nl: Doorgifte van persoonsgegevens naar andere landen dan de EU-landen, Noorwegen, IJsland en Zwitserland (samen de EER) is in beginsel verboden, maar daarop gelden verschillende uitzonderingen. Bespreek met de privacy officer (privacy.gw@uu.nl of privacy.rebo@uu.nl) welke uitzondering voor jou in aanmerking komt.
